items.title: Equation of State for an Ideal Gas (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Equation of State for an Ideal Gas: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Jo gas kinetic theory ke mutabiq chale use ideal gas kehte hain. Ideal gas ki equation (muadla) yeh hai:
Yahan P pressure, V volume, n gas ke moles ki number, R universal gas constant (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) aur T temperature hai.
Equation (6.1) batati hai ke ideal gas ke liye pressure aur volume ka product (zarb ka jawab) temperature ke directly proportional hai.
